data.one_liner: Map plain Dart objects to and from JSON without annotations or code generation
data.what_it_does: Provides a lightweight JSONObject base class that can be extended to create POJOs. It also offers a JSONTransformer for transforming JSON trees using a simple DSL.
use_when: You need quick, annotation-free JSON mapping for small to medium models
You want to support both web and native without mirrors fallback
You prefer a single dependency over code generation
avoid_when: Your project already uses a codegen-based JSON library like json_serializable
You need advanced features like nested custom converters or serialization hooks
strengths: Works on web and native out of the box
weaknesses: No support for custom converters or complex nested types
Limited to simple POJOs, no immutability or validation
No type safety for JSON keys
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, extend JSONObject

alternatives.name: json_annotation
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides codegen with type safety and custom converters
